oneOf.description: ADA — native token of the Cardano blockchain platform.
ALGO — utility token of the Algorand blockchain.
ARKM — token used within the Arkham intelligence platform.
AUR — token historically associated with the Auroracoin project.
AVAX — native asset of the Avalanche smart‑contract platform.
BCH — Bitcoin Cash, a fork of Bitcoin focused on larger block sizes.
BTC — Bitcoin, the original decentralized digital currency.
CKB — Common Knowledge Base token of the Nervos Network.
DASH — digital cash–oriented cryptocurrency offering fast settlement.
DESO — token supporting decentralized social‑network applications.
DOGE — memetic proof‑of‑work cryptocurrency based on the Dogecoin protocol.
DOT — token of the Polkadot multi‑chain interoperability platform.
EOS — token used for resources and governance on the EOSIO platform.
ETC — Ethereum Classic, maintaining Ethereum's original chain state.
ETH — native asset of the Ethereum smart‑contract network.
FIRO — privacy‑oriented cryptocurrency previously known as Zcoin.
GRC — Gridcoin, associated with distributed computing participation.
LTC — Litecoin, a peer‑to‑peer cryptocurrency based on faster block times.
MZC — Mazacoin, historically linked to community‑based digital currency projects.
NEO — token powering the Neo smart‑economy blockchain.
NMC — Namecoin, used for decentralized naming and identity.
NXT — early proof‑of‑stake cryptocurrency platform.
PPC — Peercoin, one of the earliest proof‑of‑stake systems.
SAFEMOON — token recognized for its redistribution and fee‑based model.
SHIB — Shiba Inu token, an ERC‑20 memetic digital asset.
SOL — native token of the Solana high‑throughput blockchain.
TIT — token name associated with smaller or experimental cryptocurrency projects.
TRX — Tron network token supporting smart‑contract applications.
USDT — Tether, a U.S.‑dollar–linked stablecoin.
VTC — Vertcoin, a proof‑of‑work cryptocurrency emphasizing mining accessibility.
XBT — alternative ticker widely used to denote Bitcoin.
XDG — exchange ticker variant used for Dogecoin.
XLM — Stellar Lumens, token used on the Stellar payments network.
XMR — Monero, a privacy‑preserving cryptocurrency.
XNO — Nano, a low‑latency digital currency using block‑lattice design.
XPM — Primecoin, mined via prime‑number search algorithms.
XRP — digital asset used on the XRP Ledger for cross‑ledger transfers.
XVG — Verge, a privacy‑focused cryptocurrency.
ZEC — Zcash, a cryptocurrency offering zero‑knowledge privacy features.
